text: This report provides the Board of Health with an update on the risk management reporting that is part of the Ontario Public Health Standards Accountability Framework. It outlines risks and challenges facing Toronto Public Health (TPH) in 2023, which include talent availability, uncertainty about the public health landscape, resource capacity to address evolving and emerging public health issues, and challenges securing public support and adherence to public health advice.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (March 29, 2023) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
